add.title: Refine browser scripts fail under TestRunner --browser (3)

Marked red in core/Test/browser-scripts.mjs. Fix the script or the page, then change its status to pass.

complete.outcome: composer-flow and nothing-to-refine pass fenced; dictate-flow skipped with the real reason
